items.title: Reducing Batch Makespan for LLM Agent Workloads through Inference-Environment Coordination
items.title_zh: 通过推理环境协调减少 LLM 代理工作负载的批量完工时间
items.description: Efficient batch execution of agent tasks is critical to LLM training and development workflows, including benchmark evaluation, synthetic-data generation, and RL rollouts. Since these tasks alternate between LLM inference and environment interaction, we present coordinated optimizations to reduce batch makespan, the time required to complete all tasks in a batch. For hybrid LLMs, a workload-based resource model guides GPU-memory allocation between key-value (KV) cache and recurrent state and provides a reference sample concurrency to exploit parallelism while limiting recomputation. Trajectory-aware routing and scheduling promote cache reuse while balancing worker load. Under constrained environment capacity, we decouple sample admission from environment execution and introduce Chain-Advancing Action Scheduling (CAAS), which prioritizes long chains using observed progress to shorten the batch tail. Controlled replay combines actual inference with recorded environment responses and durations for ablations of individual optimizations. Live evaluations with Ling-3.0-Flash and Ling-3.1-Flash on the BFCL, SWE-bench Multilingual, WideSearch, and MCP-Atlas benchmarks demonstrate makespan reductions of 10.4% to 65.0%, while evaluation scores remain aligned. Furthermore, these methods have been successfully applied to training and evaluation workflows for the Ling-3.x model series, accelerating the model-development cycle.
items.description_zh: 代理任务的高效批量执行对于 LLM 培训和开发工作流程至关重要，包括基准评估、合成数据生成和 RL 推出。由于这些任务在 LLM 推理和环境交互之间交替，因此我们提出了协调优化来减少批量完成时间（批量完成所有任务所需的时间）。对于混合 LLM，基于工作负载的资源模型指导键值 (KV) 缓存和循环状态之间的 GPU 内存分配，并提供参考示例并发性以利用并行性，同时限制重新计算。轨迹感知路由和调度可促进缓存重用，同时平衡工作负载。在环境容量受限的情况下，我们将样本准入与环境执行分离，并引入链推进动作调度（CAAS），它使用观察到的进度来优先考虑长链，以缩短批尾。受控重放将实际推理与记录的环境响应和单个优化消融的持续时间结合起来。在 BFCL、SWE-bench Multilingual、WideSearch 和 MCP-Atlas 基准上使用 Ling-3.0-Flash 和 Ling-3.1-Flash 进行的实时评估表明，完工时间缩短了 10.4% 至 65.0%，而评估分数保持一致。此外，这些方法已成功应用于Ling-3.x模型系列的训练和评估工作流程，加快了���型开发周期。
items.authors: Wei Feng, Meiling Chen, Boxiao Chen, Lu Liu, Bin Zi, Libin Ye, Xingyu Lu, Lei Xu, Jun Zhou

items.title: Iris-Z: Scaling One Generative Model Past Specialist Geometry Models
items.title_zh: Iris-Z：缩放一种生成模型过去的专业几何模型
items.description: Language moved from many task-specific models to one unified model: a single generative model with a single generative training task that handles all of them within the same backbone, and keeps improving with data, parameters and compute. We believe the bitter lesson applies just as much to computer vision, 3D and spatial understanding, in the end to visual intelligence: the effort should go into general architectures that solve all these tasks in a unified way, and into scaling them, rather than into task-specific designs. We test this on monocular geometry, a task that has belonged to specialised architectures for years. Iris-Z is a general image generator that produces appearance and geometry together. A single backbone denoises, reasons about and understands the image and its depth at the same time, and one set of weights generates images with their depth, estimates depth from photographs and paints images onto a given depth. At enough scale it surpasses state-of-the-art specialists on established depth benchmarks while keeping the generative abilities of the backbone it started from without specialized layers. We release two models for the community.
items.description_zh: 语言从许多特定于任务的模型转变为一个统一的模型：具有单个生成训练任务的单个生成模型，该任务在同一主干内处理所有这些模型，并通过数据、参数和计算不断改进。我们相信，这个惨痛的教训同样适用于计算机视觉、3D 和空间理解，最终适用于视觉智能：我们应该努力构建以统一方式解决所有这些任务的通用架构，并扩展它们，而不是针对特定任务的设计。我们在单目几何上对此进行了测试，这项任务多年来一直属于专门的架构。 Iris-Z 是一款通用图像生成器，可同时生成��观和几何形状。单个主干网去噪，同时推理和理解图像及其深度，一组权重生成具有深度的图像，估计照片的深度并将图像绘制到给定的深度上。在足够的规模上，它在既定的深度基准上超越了最先进的专家，同时保持了其在没有专门层的情况下开始的骨干的生成能力。我们为社区发布了两个模型。

items.title: BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction
items.description: Given a set of LEGO parts and an image of an assembled object, our task is to infer the pose of each part to assemble the object. In contrast with traditional 3D reconstruction, doing so requires satisfying discrete physical constraints, which provide structure but render the problem combinatorial and highly sensitive to small pose errors. To learn a prior over how parts fit together, we train a set-conditioned SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated assemblies. We then finetune this model to inject image conditioning, using 1% as much data. However, while the learned flow captures global structure, it does not enforce connectivity. To address this, we introduce an analytic connectivity-field guidance to pull predictions toward connected assemblies at test time. Through this, we demonstrate improved build quality with model size, pretraining, and guidance. We make our models and data available for research purposes at https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/
items.description_zh: 给定一组乐高部件和组装物体的图像，我们的任务是推断每个部件的姿势以组装物体。与传统的 3D 重建相比，这样做需要满足离散的物理约束，这些约束提供了结构，但使问题变得组合并且对小位姿误差高度敏感。为了了解零件如何组装在一起的先验知识，我们在程序生成的组件上训练了一个设置条件的 SE(3) 流模型。然后，我们使用 1% 的数据微调该模型以注入图像调节。然而，虽然学习到的流捕获了全局结构，但它并没有强制连接。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了分析连接场指导，以在测试时将预测拉向连接的组件。通过这一点，我们通过模型大小、预训练和指导展示了改进的构建质量。我们在 https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/ 上提供模型和数据用于研究目的

items.title: Restoring Diversity in Distilled Image and Video Generators by Probing Activations
items.title_zh: 通过探测激活恢复蒸馏图像和视频生成器的多样性
items.description: Distilling diffusion models into few-step student models substantially reduces sampling latency, but induces severe diversity collapse: samples generated from different random seeds show minimal variation. In this work, we investigate the root cause of this failure by probing the internal representations of student models relative to their teachers. We find that distilled students maintain total activation variance comparable to their teachers, but concentrate it into substantially fewer directions. This directional collapse is localized to an identifiable intermediate block at the initial denoising step. Consequently, diversity collapse stems from a misallocation of activation variance rather than an inherent loss of generative capacity. Guided by this finding, we propose ReDiverse to reinstate the missing variance directions. At training time, ReDiverse-FT fine-tunes a lightweight adapter that regresses student activations onto the teacher's, reviving the teacher's feature variance characteristic. At inference time, ReDiverse-TF introduces a training-free mechanism that steers activations along precomputed teacher principal directions. Across image and video distillation benchmarks, ReDiverse consistently restores sample diversity while preserving generation quality, further supported by the user study.
items.description_zh: 将扩散模型提炼为少步学生模型大大减少了采样延迟，但会导致严重的多样性崩溃：从不同随机种子生成的样本显示出最小的变化。在这项工作中，我们通过探究学生模型相对于教师的内部表征来调查这种失败的根本原因。我们发现，经过蒸馏的学生保持与老师相当的总激活方差，但将其集中在少得多的方向上。在初始去噪步骤中，这种定向塌陷被定位于可识别的中间块。因此，多样性崩溃源于激活方差的错误分配，而不是生���能力的固有损失。在此发现的指导下，我们提出 ReDiverse 来恢复缺失的方差方向。在训练时，ReDiverse-FT 微调一个轻量级适配器，将学生的激活回归到教师的激活，从而恢复教师的特征方差特征。在推理时，ReDiverse-TF 引入了一种免训练机制，可以沿着预先计算的教师主要方向引导激活。在图像和视频蒸馏基准中，ReDiverse 始终如一地恢复样本多样性，同时保持生成质量，这得到了用户研究的进一步支持。
items.authors: Furkan Horoz, Ozgur Kara, Kaan Oktay, Adil Kaan Akan, Atakan Kara, Anand Bhattad, James Matthew Rehg

items.title: Re-Search: Dissecting LLM Ideation Through a Two-Player Questioning Game
items.title_zh: 重新搜索：通过两人提问游戏剖析LLM理念
items.description: Research ideation is iterative: researchers refine their ideas step by step based on feedback. Yet existing evaluations obscure this search process, making it difficult to understand how LLMs explore the space of research ideas and what limits their progress. We introduce Re-Search, which adapts the format of Twenty Questions to research ideation: given only the research problem of a published paper, a model must rediscover the paper's core idea by asking yes-or-no questions. Built from 200 ICML 2026 papers, Re-Search tracks how a model's idea evolves as it asks questions and receives binary oracle feedback, isolating ideation from execution. Across six recent LLMs, nearly all progress happens within the first 30 of 100 questions, which largely decide how the game ends; after that, most models plateau. Through controlled interventions on the candidate questions and the hypothesis space, we find that the bottleneck is generation, not judgment: models recognize a good idea or a good question when one is offered, but often cannot produce it on their own. We further analyze the ideation traces and find that models fail by either over-exploiting one direction or over-exploring too many. These findings point to concrete design principles for autoresearch systems: since models can judge candidates they cannot produce, enriching the search with externally sourced ideas and questions may be more effective than improving any single model's generation ability.
items.description_zh: 研究构思是迭代的：研究人员根据反馈逐步完善他们的想法。然而，现有的评估掩盖了这一搜索过程，使得人们很难理解LLM如何探索研究思想的空间以及是什么限制了他们的进展。我们引入了重新搜索，它将二十个问题的格式适应研究构思：仅给出已发表论文的研究问题，模型必须通过询问是或否问题来重新发现论文的核心思想。 Re-Search 以 200 篇 ICML 2026 论文为基础，跟踪模型的想法在提出问题和接收二进制预言反馈时如何演变，从而将构思与执行隔离开来。在最近的 6 个LLM中，几乎所有进展都发生在 100 个问题中的前 30 个问题中，这在很大程度上决定了游戏的结局；此后，大多数模型都趋于稳定。通过对候选问题和假设空间的受控干预，我们发现瓶颈在于生成，而不是判断：模型在提出一个好想法或一个好问题时识别出一个好想法或一个好问题，但通常无法自行生成。我们进一步分析了构思痕迹，发现模型要么过度利用一个方向，要么过度探索太多方向而失败。这些发现指出了自动研究系统的具体设计原则：由于模型可以判断它们无法生成的候选者，因此用外部来源的想法和问题丰富搜索可能比提高任何单个模型的生成能力更有效。
items.authors: Muhan Gao, Hangxiao Zhu, Xinqi Su, Yu Zhang, Daniel Khashabi, Kuan-Hao Huang

items.title: Dual Flow: Joint Image-Measurement Interpolation for Inverse Problems
items.title_zh: 双流：逆问题的联合图像测量插值
items.description: Generative model-based approaches to linear inverse problems typically use the acquired noisy measurement to condition or guide sampling in the image domain. In this work, we introduce Dual Flow, a novel joint-flow model for solving linear inverse problems by jointly estimating the clean image and corresponding noise-free measurement from the observation. Specifically, Dual Flow formulates image reconstruction and measurement denoising as a coupled estimation problem, using coupled flows in the image and measurement domains. The acquired noisy measurement is used only to initialize the measurement state; thereafter, image and measurement states are jointly updated based on their current values. By construction, the final image and measurement estimates are guaranteed to satisfy the underlying forward model. We derive the sampling updates for the joint-flow which involves the conditional mean of the clean image given the joint state. We further derive a closed-form expression for a sufficient statistic of the joint state and show that the required conditional mean can be obtained by solving an image-domain Gaussian denoising problem involving operator-dependent, correlated noise. We train a velocity-prediction network using this formulation to estimate the conditional mean from the derived sufficient statistic. Extensive experiments across various linear inverse problems and image datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both distortion metrics and perceptual quality. Dual Flow requires no hyperparameter tuning beyond the number of inference steps and achieves shorter reconstruction times than competing methods. Additional analyses assess robustness to model mismatch, as well as the ability to generate diverse plausible reconstructions and characterize reconstruction uncertainty.
items.description_zh: 基于生成模型的线性逆问题方法通常使用获取的噪声测量来调节或指导图像域中的采样。在这项工作中，我们引入了 Dual Flow，这是一种新颖的联合流模型，用于通过联合估计干净图像和来自观察的相应无噪声测量来解决线性逆问题。具体来说，双流利用图像和测量域中的耦合流将图像重建和测量去噪表述为耦合估计问题。获取的噪声测量仅用于初始化测量状态；此后，图像和测量状态根据其当前值共同更新。通过构建，最终的图像和测量估计可以保证满足底层的正向模型。我们推导出关节流的采样更新，其中涉及给定关节状态的干净图像的条件平均值。我们进一步推导了联合状态足够统计量的封闭式表达式，并表明可以通过解决涉及算子相关的相关噪声的图像域高斯去噪问题来获得所需的条件均值。我们使用此公式训练速度预测网络，以根据导出的充分统计量估计条件平均值。跨各种线性逆问题和图像数据集的广泛实验证明了失真指标和感知质量方面最先进的性能。双流不需要超出推理步骤数量的超参数调整，并且比竞争方法实现更短的重建时间。其他分析评估了模型失配的稳健性，以及生成各种合理重建和表征重建不确定性的能力。
items.authors: Sevket Ege Yesilyurt, Figen S. Oktem

items.title: EvenVLM: A Text and Multimodal Dataset for the Even Language with Vision-Language Fine-Tuning
items.title_zh: EvenVLM：具有视觉语言微调功能的 Even 语言的文本和多模态数据集
items.description: We present EvenVLM, the first text and multimodal (VQA) dataset for Even (Lamut), an endangered Northern Tungusic language spoken by approximately 6,800 people in Siberia. Our dataset comprises 50,521 structured Even-Russian entries extracted from dictionary and phrasebook sources via GPT-4o Mini-based parsing, from which we synthetically generate 107,543 training examples spanning translation, grammar, reading comprehension, and semantic classification. To address tokenization inefficiency on Even's agglutinative morphology, we propose a three-step tokenizer expansion algorithm that adds Even-specific graphemes (eng, oe, o-umlaut), whitelisted vocabulary, and BPE merges, reducing average tokens per word by 27% (4.99 to 3.64). Using LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen3-VL-4B, we adapt the model for text tasks (0.53% trainable parameters, rank 32) and separately for visual question answering (rank 64, frozen vision encoder). Our best configuration achieves 11.4% exact match and a 13.6 weighted score on text benchmarks, 0.1283 chrF for sentence translation, and 65% accuracy on VQA (up from 0% for the base model and text-only fine-tuning). We release our datasets, evaluation benchmarks, and training pipeline to support further research on Even and other low-resource languages.
items.description_zh: 我们推出 EvenVLM，这是 Even (Lamut) 的第一个文本和多模态 (VQA) 数据集，Even (Lamut) 是一种濒临灭绝的北通古斯语言，西伯利亚约有 6,800 人使用。我们的数据集包含通过基于 GPT-4o Mini 的解析从词典和短语手册源中提取的 50,521 个结构化偶俄语条目，从中我们综合生成了 107,543 个涵盖翻译、语法、阅读理解和语义分类的训练示例。为了解决 Even 凝集形态上标记化效率低下的问题，我们提出了一种三步标记器扩展算法，该算法添加了 Even 特定的字素（eng、oe、o-umlaut）、白名单词汇和 BPE 合并，将每个单词的平均标记减少了 27%（4.99 至 3.64）。使用 Qwen3-VL-4B 的 LoRA 微调，我们使模型适应文本任务（0.53% 可训练参数，排名 32），并单独适应视觉问答（排名 64，冻结视觉编码器）。我们的最佳配置在文本基准上实现了 11.4% 的精确匹配和 13.6 的加权分数，句子翻译的 0.1283 chrF，以及 VQA 的 65% 的准确率（基础模型和纯文本微调的准确率为 0%）。我们发布数据集、评估基准和训练管道，以支持 Even 和其他低资源语言的进一步研究。

items.title: LuthorSQL: A One-Pass Text-to-SQL Model as System 1 for a Slower LLM Agent
items.title_zh: LuthorSQL：作为系统 1 的一次性文本到 SQL 模型，适用于较慢的 LLM 代理
items.description: Frontier LLM agents that query databases with tools are among the most accurate text-to-SQL systems, but per-query calls to a hosted model are slow, costly, and expose sensitive organizational queries to external APIs. For example, a Claude Opus 5.5 agent serving 10,000 queries a day costs over $70,000 a year at list price. To what extent can local hardware already owned by an organization offload this burden without compromising the agent's accuracy? We present LuthorSQL, a non-autoregressive 7B text-to-SQL model that serves as a rapid System 1 gate for a slower LLM agent (System 2), escalating queries only when uncertain. LuthorSQL makes a single forward pass to predict slot scores over a bounded grammar for query plans, compiles and runs up to 32 candidate plans, and chooses an answer using a trained validator. On its own, LuthorSQL reaches 68.03% execution accuracy on BIRD's hidden test set at 0.84 s per question on a single GPU, maintains its accuracy in 9 GB with 8-bit quantized weights, and transfers zero-shot to Snowflake, BigQuery, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and DuckDB within 3.1 points of its native SQLite accuracy. Combined with Claude Opus 5.5 in a pre-registered confidence cascade over 227 questions on databases published after Opus's training cutoff, LuthorSQL answers nearly half of all questions locally and cuts API cost by 33.3% at the same accuracy. Finally, contamination probing shows that Opus reproduces 48-92% of public benchmark gold queries verbatim without seeing the schema; however, its tool-assisted accuracy holds on renamed schemas and reaches 95.6-97.4% on post-cutoff databases. Code and data: https://github.com/IAMIbrahimmemon/luthorsql
items.description_zh: 使用工具查询数据库的 Frontier LLM 代理是最准确的文本到 SQL 系统之一，但对托管模型的每次查询调用速度慢、成本高，并且会将敏感的组织查询暴露给外部 API。例如，每天处理 10,000 个查询的 Claude Opus 5.5 代理每年的成本超过 70,000 美元（按标价计算）。组织已经拥有的本地硬件可以在多大程度上减轻这种负担而不影响代理的准确性？我们提出了 LuthorSQL，一种非自回归 7B 文本到 SQL 模型，可作为较慢的 LLM 代理（系统 2）的快速系统 1 入口，仅在不确定时升级查询。 LuthorSQL 通过一次前向传递来预测查询计划的有界语法上的槽分数，编译并运行多达 32 个候选计划，并使用经过训练的验证器选择答案。就其本身而言，LuthorSQL 在 BIRD 的隐藏测试集上达到了 68.03% 的执行准确度，在单个 GPU 上每个问题 0.84 秒，在 8 位量化权重下将其准确度保持在 9 GB，并将零样本传输到 Snowflake、BigQuery、MySQL、PostgreSQL 和 DuckDB，其本机 SQLite 准确度的误差在 3.1 个点之内。与 Claude Opus 5.5 相结合，LuthorSQL 在 Opus 训练截止后发布的数据库中预先注册了超过 227 个问题的置信度级联，LuthorSQL 在本地回答了近一半的问题，并在相同的精度下将 API 成本降低了 33.3%。最后，污染探测表明 Opus 可以逐字重现 48-92% 的公共基准黄金查询，而无需查看架构；然而，其工具辅助的准确性在重命名模式上保持不变，并且在截断后数据库上达到 95.6-97.4%。代码和数据：https://github.com/IAMIbrahimmemon/luthorsql
items.authors: Ibrahim Memon, Armin Karamzade, M. Hanif Jhaveri, Roy Fox

items.title: Alloy: A Multi-Material Physics Engine for Robot Learning
items.title_zh: Alloy：用于机器人学习的多材料物理引擎
items.description: Robots handle much more than rigid objects: towels, cables, water, sand. The simulators used to train robots at scale are strongest on rigid bodies, and adding another material usually means a second engine and hand-written glue between the two. We present Alloy, an open-source physics engine for robot learning in which rigid robots, cloth, cables, liquids, granular material and soft bodies share one scene. Each object is described once; Alloy assigns it to a solver suited to its material, couples the solvers inside every control step, and runs the scene in many parallel worlds on one GPU, or on a CPU. Every world carries a health grade, to help tell a failure of the physics from a failure of the policy. Alloy is built on Newton, MuJoCo Warp and Warp, and it is written to be driven by coding agents: its documentation ships inside the package, every error names its fix, and the engine is exposed as tools over the Model Context Protocol. In a cold test, agents that had never seen Alloy installed a pre-release from the package index and trained policies for walking, cable handling and pouring on a single GPU. We also report how throughput grows with the number of worlds, depth-camera throughput, agreement with closed-form references, and a reliability test over a thousand worlds.
items.description_zh: 机器人处理的不仅仅是刚性物体：毛巾、电缆、水、沙子。用于大规模训练机器人的模拟器在刚体上最强，添加另一种材料通常意味着第二个引擎和两者之间的手写胶水。我们推出 Alloy，一种用于机器人学习的开源物理引擎，其中刚性机器人、布料、电缆、液体、颗粒材料和软体共享一个场景。每个对象被描述一次； Alloy 将其分配给适合其材质的解算器，将解算器耦合到每个控制步骤中，并在一个 GPU 或 CPU 上运行多个并行世界中的场景。每个世界都有一个健康等级，以帮助区分物理失败和政策失败。 Alloy 是基于 Newton、MuJoCo Warp 和 Warp 构建的，它被编写为由编码代理驱动：它的文档包含在包内，每个错误都命名其修复，并且引擎通过模型上下文协议作为工具公开。在冷测试中，从未见过 Alloy 的代理安装了包索引中的预发布版本，并在单个 GPU 上训练了行走、电缆处理和浇注的策略。我们还报告了吞吐量如何随着世界数量、深度相机吞吐量、与封闭形式参考的一致性以及一千多个世界的可靠性测试而增长。

items.title: Parsed, Plausible, Wrong: Output Format Controls Silent Errors in Small-Model Semantic Parsing
items.title_zh: 解析的、合理的、错误的：输出格式控制小模型语义解析中的无声错误
items.description: A small fine-tuned parser that emits a well-formed but wrong tree fails silently: nothing downstream can tell. We ask whether the output format, a free design choice, controls how often this happens. On the PIZZA ordering benchmark we fine-tune two sub-billion models (Qwen3.5-0.8B and LFM2.5-350M) with LoRA on six lossless encodings of the same target tree, from 44.3 down to 10.9 tokens per order, including two matched-length pairs that vary surface form at fixed length. Across 300 runs (5 training pool sizes, 5 seeds) with a hierarchical bootstrap and Holm correction fixed before the results were read, shortening alone never helps, but writing the target in ordinary words does. The word encoding is the most accurate format on both models (87.5% vs. 85.8% exact match for the native s-expression on Qwen) while emitting 4.1x fewer tokens, and it cuts the silent error rate by 2.3x on Qwen and 1.8x on LFM2, separating at every pool size. Error analysis locates much of the gain in negation. All runs also learn to refuse off-menu input (held out: 95.9-99.0% handled) and to apply in-utterance self-corrections. Strict refusal has a measured price: 2.1-10.1% of real, mostly polite, orders are refused.
items.description_zh: 一个小型的微调解析器发出一个格式良好但错误的树，它会默默地失败：下游无法告诉。我们询问输出格式（自由设计选择）是否控制这种情况发生的频率。在 PIZZA 排序基准上，我们使用 LoRA 在同一目标树的六种无损编码上微调两个数十亿个模型（Qwen3.5-0.8B 和 LFM2.5-350M），每个订单从 44.3 个令牌减少到 10.9 个令牌，包括两个以固定长度改变表面形式的匹配长度对。在 300 次运行（5 个训练池大小、5 个种子）中，在读取结果之前修复了分层引导程序和 Holm 校正，单独缩短永远不会有帮助，但用普通文字编写目标却可以。单词编码是两种模型上最准确的格式（Qwen 上原生 s 表达式的精确匹配率为 87.5% 与 85.8%），同时发出的标记数量减少了 4.1 倍，并且将 Qwen 上的静默错误率降低了 2.3 倍，在 LFM2 上降低了 1.8 倍，在每个池大小上都进行了分离。误差分析发现大部分增益来自于否定。所有运行还学会拒绝菜单外输入（坚持：95.9-99.0％已处理）并应用话语中的自我更正。严格拒绝有一个衡量的价格：真实订单的2.1-10.1%，大多数是礼貌的，订单被拒绝。
items.authors: Umar Ahmed, Maxim Dunaev, Mohammad Nour Al Awad, Sergey Ivanov, Ivan Khodnenko

items.title: MemInStream: Memorizing or Merely Recognizing? Rethinking Streaming Video Memory Evaluation
items.title_zh: MemInStream：记忆还是仅仅识别？重新思考流视频内存评估
items.description: Streaming video understanding aims to continuously process incoming visual observations, making the retention and retrieval of relevant information increasingly important as the video history grows. Although existing benchmarks include memory-related questions, question-answering accuracy alone does not reliably measure memory capabilities. Incorrect predictions may arise from failures in visual understanding rather than forgetting, whereas correct predictions may rely on linguistic priors or recent observations without requiring historical memory. To address these ambiguities, we introduce MemInStream, a benchmark dedicated to evaluating memory capabilities in streaming video understanding. We develop an evidence-controlled validation protocol that associates each question with temporally localized evidence intervals. The protocol validates evidence solvability and memory necessity by retaining questions that models can answer from the annotated evidence but cannot resolve using recent observations, post-evidence observations, or textual input alone. This helps disentangle memory limitations from understanding failures while reducing memory-independent shortcuts. MemInStream provides a systematic evaluation of memory capabilities through four major categories, covering Episodic Retrieval, State Tracking \& Updating, Multi-Evidence Integration, and Contextual Memory across diverse video scenarios. Overall, MemInStream provides a comprehensive and reliable benchmark for systematically evaluating memory capabilities in streaming video understanding.
items.description_zh: 流视频理解旨在持续处理传入的视觉观察结果，随着视频历史的增长，相关信息的保留和检索变得越来越重要。尽管现有的基准测试包括与记忆相关的问题，但仅靠问答准确性并不能可靠地衡量记忆能力。错误的预测可能是由于视觉理解的失败而不是遗忘而引起的，而正确的预测可能依赖于语言先验或最近的观察，而不需要历史记忆。为了解决这些歧义，我们引入了 MemInStream，这是一个致力于评估流视频理解中的内存能力的基准测试。我们开发了一种证据控制的验证协议，将每个问题与时间局部的证据区间相关联。该协议通过保留模型可以从带注释的证据中回答但无法仅使用最近的观察、证据后观察或单独的文本输入来解决的问题来验证证据的可解决性和记忆的必要性。这有助于解决内存限制与理解故障的问题，同时减少与内存无关的快捷方式。 MemInStream 通过四个主要类别提供对记忆能力的系统评估，涵盖情景检索、状态跟踪和更新、多证据集成以及跨不同视频场景的上下文记忆。总体而言，MemInStream 为系统评估流视频理解中的内存能力提供了全面且可靠的基准。
items.authors: Zhenqi He, Dunyuan Xu, Yang Bo, Kien T. Pham, Yanghao Wang, Shuhan Li, Xintong Guo, Yuyang He, Fang Liu, Huankang Guan, Jingyan Chen, Rui Liu, Long Chen

items.title: OneSteer: Unlocking Steerable General Humanoid Motion Tracking via One-Step Diffusion Whole-Body Control
items.title_zh: OneSteer：通过一步扩散全身控制解锁可操纵的通用人形运动跟踪
items.description: Deployment objectives often specify desired outcomes without providing revised trajectories, while parts of the original reference must still be followed. We present OneSteer, a one-step diffusion whole-body controller that combines general motion tracking with selective test-time steering. To accommodate new objectives, differentiable task costs guide optimization of the generator's input noise with frozen weights, while body-group reference masks relax selected tracking requirements. Predicted state-action plans provide a shared interface for task optimization and feedback-conditioned execution. For nominal tracking, the model trained from scratch achieves the lowest local tracking error among the evaluated baselines on successful held-out AMASS and BONES clips. For steering, one frozen distilled controller adapts across diverse deployment objectives in simulation, raising the clean passage rate under a 1.25 m bar from 2% to 90%. On a physical Unitree G1, OneSteer completes all 27 nominal tracking trials across nine diverse whole-body motion sequences without falling. With a steering cost derived from a signed distance field built using only onboard LiDAR, it also passes under a 1.1 m low bar in four of five attempts and steps over a 12 cm hurdle without falling in all three attempts. Beyond control, prediction variation in the model trained from scratch ranks likely tracking failures without physics rollouts. This scoring method is more than 10x faster than simulation-based scoring with five rollouts per clip and guides targeted fine-tuning. Project page: https://onesteer.github.io
items.description_zh: 部署目标通常会指定期望的结果，而不提供修改的轨迹，而原始参考的部分内容仍必须遵循。我们推出了 OneSteer，这是一种单步扩散全身控制器，它将一般运动跟踪与选择性测试时间转向相结合。为了适应新的目标，可微分的任务成本指导使用冻结权重优化生成器的输入噪声，而身体组参考掩模放宽了选定的跟踪要求。预测状态行动计划为任务优化和反馈条件执行提供了一个共享接口。对于标称跟踪，从头开始训练的模型在成功保���的 AMASS 和 BONES 剪辑的评估基线中实现了最低的局部跟踪误差。对于转向，一个冷冻蒸馏控制器可适应模拟中的不同部署目标，将 1.25 m bar 下的干净通过率从 2% 提高到 90%。在实体 Unitree G1 上，OneSteer 完成了九个不同全身运动序列的全部 27 次标称跟踪试验，没有摔倒。由于转向成本源自仅使用机载 LiDAR 构建的有符号距离场，因此它在五次尝试中的四次中也通过了 1.1 m 的低栏，并且在所有 3 次尝试中跨过 12 cm 的障碍而没有摔倒。除了控制之外，从头开始训练的模型中的预测变化会在没有物理推出的情况下对可能的跟踪失败进行排名。这种评分方法比基于模拟的评分快 10 倍以上，每个剪辑有 5 次滚动，并指导有针对性的微调。项目页面：https://onesteer.github.io
items.authors: Yifei Huang, Yazhao Yang, Li Weijia, Tianle Shi, Ji Jin, Zhihui Cai, Zihao Liu, Jianzhuang Zhao, Songlin Dong, Xinyuan Chang, Yihong Gong, Dian Shen, Zhiheng Ma

items.title: Interpreting Coding Agents Through Their Behavioral Trajectories
items.title_zh: 通过行为轨迹解释编码代理
items.description: Standard coding-agent benchmarks primarily evaluate binary task success, treating execution as a black box and obscuring the behaviors that produce those outcomes. We analyze a large corpus of 143,209 execution trajectories from 125 agent configurations spanning 117 unique models. To enable comparisons across heterogeneous agent interfaces, we develop a rule-based parser that maps raw execution traces to high-level actions such as repository search, file editing, and test execution, and audit its predictions against a six-model consensus reference on 500 events. We find that agents with similar solve rates can nevertheless differ substantially in how they explore, modify and verify code. Moreover, without using task outcomes, token counts, or tool names as features, aggregate behavioral profiles retrieve the corresponding agent stack across disjoint repository sets and programming languages, although task composition is not fully controlled in the cross-repository setting. Through analyses of frontier models and agent scaffolds, we further show that scaffold choice and reasoning effort systematically shift agents' search, editing, and testing behavior. We release the deterministic parser together with the full annotation and analysis pipeline alongside an annotated trajectory subset.
items.description_zh: 标准编码代理基准主要评估二元任务的成功，将执行视为黑匣子并掩盖产生这些结果的行为。我们分析了来自 125 个代理配置、涵盖 117 个独特模型的 143,209 个执行轨迹的大型语料库。为了能够跨异构代理接口进行比较，我们开发了一个基于规则的解析器，将原始执行跟踪映射到存储库搜索、文件编辑和测试执行等高级操作，并根据 500 个事件的六模型共识参考审核其预测。我们发现，具有相似解决率的代理在探索、修改和验证代码的方式上可能存在很大差异。此外，在不使用任务结果、令牌计数或工具名称作为特征的情况下，聚合行为配置文件跨不相交的存储库集和编程语言检索相应的代理堆栈，尽管任务组合在跨存储库设置中并未完全控制。通过对前沿模型和代理支架的分析，我们进一步表明支架选择和推理工作系统地改变了代理的搜索、编辑和测试行为。我们发布了确定性解析器以及完整的注释和分析管道以及带注释的轨迹子集。

items.title: eDMD: Endpoint Distribution Matching for Few-Step Diffusion Distillation
items.title_zh: eDMD：少步扩散蒸馏的终点分布匹配
items.description: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) has emerged as a leading paradigm for distilling diffusion models into few-step students, where an auxiliary fake score model tracks the student's distribution and the discrepancy between the teacher and fake predictions drives the student toward the teacher. In multi-step distillation, although only the student's final output is delivered, existing methods train the fake model on intermediate states or across all denoising steps. Consequently, the student's update signal becomes entangled with intermediate distributions, which can distort the matching direction and remain nonzero even after the student's final outputs already match the teacher distribution. To resolve this mismatch, we propose Endpoint Distribution Matching Distillation (eDMD), which trains a single shared fake model exclusively on the student's final outputs and uses it to correct every denoising step. Our theoretical analysis proves that this endpoint reference guarantees that the distribution matching term vanishes if and only if the student's final output distribution matches the teacher's, regardless of intermediate distributions. Beyond the fake reference, we further strengthen teacher supervision through a precise teacher (PT) that replaces single-step guided predictions with short multi-step trajectories on the final noise interval, paired with a calibrated query density for intermediate steps. Experiments on SD3-Medium, FLUX.2-klein (4B and 9B), and Qwen-Image-2.1 demonstrate that eDMD consistently outperforms existing distribution matching methods for 4-step generation.
items.description_zh: 分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）已成为将扩散模型蒸馏为几步学生的领先范例，其中辅助假分数模型跟踪学生的分布，并且教师和假预测之间的差异驱使学生转向教师。在多步骤蒸馏中，虽然只提供学生的最终输出，但现有方法会在中间状态或所有去噪步骤上训练假模型。因此，学生的更新信号与中间分布纠缠在一起，这可能会扭曲匹配方向并保持非零，即使学生的最终输出已经与教师分布匹配。为了解决这种不匹配问题，我们提出了端点分布匹配蒸馏（eDMD），它专门根据学生的最终输出训练单个共享假模型，并使用它来纠正每个去噪步骤。我们的理论分析证明，当且仅当学生的最终输出分布与教师的匹配时，无论中间分布如何，该端点参考保证分布匹配项消失。除了假参考之外，我们还通过精确教师（PT）进一步加强教师监督，该精确教师用最终噪声区间上的短多步轨迹取代单步引导预测，并与中间步骤的校准查询密度配对。 SD3-Medium、FLUX.2-klein（4B 和 9B）和 Qwen-Image-2.1 上的实验表明，对于 4 步生成，eDMD 始终优于现有的分布匹配方法。
items.authors: Tong Zhao, Xianfang Zeng, Yucheng Han, Ruoyu Wang, Mingkun Lei, Gang Yu, Chi Zhang

items.title: DySENSE: Dynamic Spatiotemporal ENergy Synthesis and Emulation with Satellite Imagery
items.title_zh: DySENSE：利用卫星图像进行动态时空能量合成和仿真
items.description: Cities account for over two-thirds of the world's energy and more than 70% of global carbon dioxide emissions. City energy is essential for achieving the 2050 net-zero target and the UN's Sustainable Development Goals 7 and 11. Although existing studies have made progress, they are limited by data and methodological gaps. Existing studies are largely predictive for existing cities rather than generative for future cities; fine-grained, aligned monthly dynamic energy data are scarce; and existing GenAI models struggle to generate dynamic urban functional monthly energy. We present DySENSE, a joint multimodal GenAI framework that synthesizes static urban satellite imagery together with spatially aligned, dynamic monthly building energy consumption maps. We decouple long-term static urban morphology from short-term dynamic energy consumption. By conditioning on static urban land use, DySENSE can generate realistic, diverse and new static urban imagery with aligned energy maps. By conditioning on dynamic monthly and climate prompts, DySENSE can jointly generate dynamic, monthly energy consumption maps while keeping the urban morphology static. Experiments across four cities (New York, Washington, Norfolk, Busan) demonstrated that DySENSE can generate annotated high-fidelity synthetic energy data using less than 25% labelled data, boosting downstream prediction performance by 8% mIoU, and achieving strong energy dynamic consistency. Compared to existing methods, DySENSE significantly improved prediction performance (8.7% accuracy) and reduced prediction error (9%-18% CVRMSE, ASHRAE). DySENSE offers an effective foundation for energy-efficient cities, peak-load analysis, building performance simulation and dynamic demand response for city, energy, and building science. The data and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/skl24/MUSE2 and https://github.com/kailaisun/DySENSE
items.description_zh: 城市消耗了全球三分之二以上的能源，占全球二氧化碳排放量的70%以上。城市能源对于实现 2050 年净零排放目标以及联合国可持续发展目标 7 和 11 至关重要。尽管现有研究取得了进展，但受到数据和方法差距的限制。现有的研究主要是对现有城市的预测，而不是对未来城市的生成；细粒度、一致的每月动态能源数据稀缺；现有的 GenAI 模型很难产生动态的城市功能性每月能源。我们推���了 DySENSE，这是一个联合多模式 GenAI 框架，它将静态城市卫星图像与空间对齐的动态每月建筑能耗地图合成在一起。我们将长期静态城市形态与短期动态能源消耗脱钩。通过调节静态城市土地利用，DySENSE 可以生成具有对齐能量图的真实、多样化和新的静态城市图像。通过调节动态的每月和气候提示，DySENSE 可以共同生成动态的每月能源消耗地图，同时保持城市形态静态。在四个城市（纽约、华盛顿、诺福克、釜山）的实验表明，DySENSE 可以使用少于 25% 的���记数据生成带注释的高保真合成能源数据，将下游预测性能提升 8% mIoU，并实现强大的能源动态一致性。与现有方法相比，DySENSE 显着提高了预测性能（8.7% 准确度）并降低了预测误差（9%-18% CVRMSE、ASHRAE）。 DySENSE 为城市、能源和建筑科学的节能城市、峰值负载分析、建筑性能模拟和动态需求响应提供了有效的基础。数据和代码：https://huggingface.co/datasets/skl24/MUSE2 和 https://github.com/kailaisun/DySENSE
items.authors: Kailai Sun, Zijie Gao, Mingyi He, Can Rong, Alok Prakash, Baoshen Guo, Shenhao Wang, Jinhua Zhao
